title: NSGo game baked light probe grid (version 1)
description: LightProbeGridDoc is the versioned YAML document storing a baked [LightProbeGrid]: its world-space axis-aligned bounds, [nx, ny, nz] lattice counts, and nx*ny*nz per-probe L2 spherical harmonic irradiance entries in (iz*ny + iy)*nx + ix order.

version.description: Version is the schema version; it must be [LightProbeGridVersion] (1).

boundsMin.description: BoundsMin is the minimum [x, y, z] corner of the grid's world-space AABB.

boundsMax.description: BoundsMax is the maximum [x, y, z] corner of the grid's world-space AABB.

counts.description: Counts holds the [nx, ny, nz] probe counts along the X, Y, and Z axes (each >= 1).

probes.description: Probes holds the nx*ny*nz baked irradiance probes in (iz*ny + iy)*nx + ix order.

LightProbeSHDoc.description: LightProbeSHDoc stores the 9 RGB L2 spherical harmonic irradiance coefficients of one baked light probe.

sh.description: SH holds the 9 cosine-convolved L2 spherical harmonic RGB coefficients matching [IrradianceSH.Coeff].
